cards.title: Amazon's share of product searches and first-page ecommerce results
cards.claim: The passage states Amazon is a platform where around 50% of product searches start, and Amazon takes 50 to 60% of first-page results in terms of e-commerce; paid search ads are competitive between Amazon and Google.
cards.action: Treat Amazon as a major ecommerce search channel/competitor when planning ecommerce search and paid search, because the passage describes Amazon/Google competition in advertising and e-commerce.
applies_when: Paid search advertising involving Amazon and Google
do_not_use_when: When seeking verified current market-share data, because the passage gives no source or date
unknowns: Source, date, geography, and methodology for the 50% and 50–60% figures
Whether these percentages generalize to all product categories or markets
evidence_quotes: Amazon is a platform where around 50% of your product searches starts.
Amazon is taking your 50 to 60% of first page result in terms of e-commerce.
paid search ads are getting very competitive with the Amazon.

cards.title: Transactional queries and ecommerce conversion optimization
cards.claim: Transactional queries indicate commercial intent such as purchasing, downloading, or signing up; examples include 'buy iPhone 15 online', 'SEO courses subscription', 'book hotel in Goa', and 'best price for posting plan'.
cards.action: For transactional queries, use conversion optimization, landing pages, schema markup, product review and offer, structured data for rich results, and tag management; optimize transactional keywords to increase ROI and CTR.
applies_when: Queries show commercial intent or transaction intent
do_not_use_when: When schema/rich-result eligibility or implementation is not verified
unknowns: Exact schema markup types and tag-management steps
Whether ROI and CTR increases are guaranteed or measured
evidence_quotes: transactional it means the name suggest transaction means the commercial intent
you can use on the basis of conversion optimization, landing pages and schema markup.
product review and offer you can utilize with the transactional queries.
You can use a structured data to appear in the rich result
optimize your transactional keywords to increase ROI and CTR.

cards.title: Navigational queries and branded SEO
cards.claim: Navigational queries occur when people already know the brand name and seek specific information or a specific website; examples include Facebook login, YouTube, Nike official website, and ChatGPT OpenAI; these queries matter for branded SEO and reputation management.
cards.action: For navigational queries, focus on branded SEO and reputation management, ensure ranking first with the brand name, and utilize branded information through Google Business listing to enhance it.
applies_when: Queries include a known brand or company name
do_not_use_when: If Google Business listing is not applicable
unknowns: How to ensure first-position ranking for brand terms
Whether Google Business listing is relevant to all business types
No performance metrics or implementation details

it is important for the branded SEO and reputation management
you should ensure that you should rank first with your brand name
